opportunities.title: FY27 Renewal - FJC Immigration Legal Center
opportunities.agency: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
opportunities.vendor: New York Legal Assistance Group Inc.
opportunities.summary: The Department of Social Services/Human Resources Administration is renewing a contract with the Office of Civil Justice and the Mayor’s Office to End Domestic and Gender-Based Violence to provide core civil legal services at the five New York City Family Justice Centers. The services will assist survivors of domestic and gender-based violence and their children with immigration-related matters, including applications for status, representation before agencies and courts, and support for self-represented clients. The award is a FY27 renewal under the agency’s renewal selection method.

opportunities.title: In-Person/VRI interpretation for Spoken Languages Services
opportunities.summary: The NYC Administration for Children’s Services is awarding three contracts to provide in‑person and video‑remote interpreting for spoken languages, deaf/hard‑of‑hearing interpretation, language services, and written translation. These services will support ACS and its provider network in serving limited‑English‑proficient and deaf/hard‑of‑hearing families, with contracts running from July 1 2026 to June 30 2029 under a competitive sealed‑proposal process.

opportunities.title: Deaf/Hard-of-Hearing Language Access Services
opportunities.summary: The Administration for Children’s Services (ACS) is awarding a contract, via competitive sealed proposals, to provide sign language interpretation services—including in‑person, on‑site, and on‑demand video remote interpretation of American Sign Language, Certified Deaf Interpretation, foreign sign languages, and CART—for ACS and its network of providers serving limited‑English‑proficient and deaf/hard‑of‑hearing families. The contract term runs from July 1 2026 through June 30 2029.

opportunities.title: Translation Services
opportunities.summary: The NYC Administration for Children's Services is procuring three contracts to deliver in-person and video remote interpretation for spoken languages and for deaf/hard‑of‑hearing clients, as well as written translation services. The contracts will support compliance with local and federal language access laws and run from July 1, 2026 through June 30, 2029.

opportunities.title: FY27 Renewal - NYCitizenship Program
opportunities.agency: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
opportunities.vendor: New York Legal Assistance Group Inc.
opportunities.summary: The Department of Social Services/Human Resources Administration is renewing a FY27 contract to provide legal screenings and free legal assistance through the naturalization process for participants in the NYCitizenship Program. The services aim to help clients become eligible for greater SSI benefits and reduce reliance on DSS assistance.

opportunities.title: Outside Land Use & Zoning Counsel with respect to the Science Park & Research Campus (SPARC) Kips Bay Project
opportunities.address: One Liberty Plaza, 165 Broadway, 14th Floor Mailroom, New York, NY 10006
opportunities.summary: The New York City Economic Development Corporation is soliciting proposals from law firms to serve as outside legal counsel to analyze, draft, and review applications for tax‑lot apportionments and zoning‑lot subdivisions for Manhattan Tax Block 962, part of Lot 100, supporting the Science Park & Research Campus (SPARC) Kips Bay development and related building‑permit filings. The engagement requires expertise in the NYC Zoning Resolution, ULURP, special‑permit procedures, DOB requirements, and Finance Department tax‑lot apportionment rules, and will be awarded through an RFP process.

opportunities.title: American Sign Language (ASL) Interpretation
opportunities.address: 100 Church Street, 12th Floor, New York, NY 10007
opportunities.summary: The Campaign Finance Board will award a negotiated acquisition contract to LC Interpreting Services LLC (doing business as SignNexus) for American Sign Language (ASL) interpretation services. The contract is capped at $99,999 and will span from August 1 2025 to July 31 2027.
